Overview

The economics of Blockchain & Digital Trust for Advertising & MarTech flipped in the last two years: runtimes got durable, evaluation became routine, and orchestration frameworks matured into something you can run under change control. What separates winners now is integration discipline — how cleanly the capability plugs into OSS/BSS stacks without inventing a shadow estate. The Telecom, Media & Entertainment operating reality gives this work its shape: churn propensity pressure at event speed, GDPR / privacy regimes obligations on every artifact, and practitioners who will not accept recommendations they cannot interrogate. The pattern below is calibrated to those three forces.
